card.name: Hyphens and joiners inside split terms
card.fires_on: Connector marks such as hyphens, a dash before 'and', or a stray break inside a compound or split word, plus the word 'or' between dose options. The next piece usually continues the term.

modes.label: Hyphen in compound
modes.description: A hyphen inside a hyphenated medical term where the second half comes after, as in pre- and post-surgery.
modes.example: Interrupt RHAPSIDO for 3 to 7 days pre<<->> and post-surgery.

modes.label: Dose alternative 'or'
modes.description: The word 'or' joining alternative dosing schedules.
modes.example: (thirty minutes before each meal and at bedtime),<< or>> 10 mg taken three times daily

modes.label: Break inside a word or URL
modes.description: A broken character, space or dot partway through a word or web address.
modes.example: Toll-free telephone: 800-647-5463 Web site: http://www.nationalgeographic<<.>> com

card.plain: It fires on hyphens and similar joins in the middle of a term, where the rest of the term is still to come.
